annotation.title_en: National AI Action Plan for Thailand Development, 6-Year Period (2022–2027)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministry of Higher Education, Science, Research and Innovation; Ministry of Digital Economy and Society (Thailand)
annotation.summary_en: Thailand's six-year National AI Action Plan (2022–2027) from the digital and higher-education ministries. It sets five strategies: ethics, law and regulation; infrastructure; AI talent; research and innovation; and industry and business uptake, including a sandbox. It proposes a National AI Committee. Embodied AI is not addressed specifically.
key_provisions_or_claims: Five strategies: AI ethics/law/regulation readiness, infrastructure, talent, R&D, and industrial adoption
Calls for AI governance policies, guidelines, rules, standards and related laws
Proposes a National AI Committee, secretariat and subcommittees to drive implementation
Proposes AI Centers of Excellence, AI consortium and a business innovation sandbox
Targets include 30,000 AI personnel and 100 prototypes in six years, with a focus on 10 target economic sectors
